# amux

Run coding agents on your own machines and follow them from anywhere.

agents.name: readme
agents.prompt: Read README.md and add a short Getting started section to it.

agents.name: tide-pools
agents.prompt: Write a poem of thirty short stanzas about tide pools into poem.md. Add one stanza at a time, each with its own edit, rereading the file before each one.

agents.name: site-summary
agents.prompt: Look through this repository and say in three sentences what it is.

agents.name: notes
agents.prompt: Create notes.md with a one-line summary of this folder.

agents.name: sensor-logger
agents.prompt: Say hello and name the folder you are working in.

agents.name: backups
agents.prompt: List the files in this folder and say how many there are.
